name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
access: No API key; bounded record client implemented
imageRights: Object-specific public domain flag and image rights
role: Global collection records, artists, dates, materials, collection images
warning: Search moved to /public/collection/v1.1/search; do not use retired /v1/search. Bulk enumeration uses objects or a verified dataset snapshot.

name: Art Institute of Chicago
access: No-key public API; bounded record client implemented
metadataRights: Check API licensing terms before bulk republication
imageRights: Check is_public_domain and image rights; IIIF is transport, not permission
role: Collection records, artist authorities, IIIF images
warning: Use data dumps for large acquisition. API availability was not verified in this runtime.

name: Rijksmuseum
access: Search, resolver, LDES, OAI-PMH and dumps documented
metadataRights: Validate applicable dataset licence during adapter work
warning: Canonical identifiers use id.rijksmuseum.nl; data.rijksmuseum.nl is a data access URL. Search is keyless at /search/collection; old Rijksstudio recipes are not the integration contract.

name: Getty AAT / ULAN / TGN
access: LOD records, SPARQL, reconciliation and N-Triples downloads
metadataRights: ODC-By 1.0; attribute Getty and contributors as applicable
imageRights: No image licence granted by an authority record
role: Vocabulary, artist identities, places and hierarchical/associative links
warning: XML/relational releases and XML web services discontinued; archived data dated 2026-01-30 are not current feeds.

name: PeriodO
access: Public JSON / Turtle / CSV and client
role: Authority-scoped historical, art-historical and archaeological period definitions
warning: Keep author, region, source, and bounds. Similar labels do not identify the same period definition.

name: Wikidata
access: Linked Data interface, APIs, dumps, query service
imageRights: Commons media have separate file licences
role: Cross-source identifiers, multilingual labels, candidate relationship discovery
warning: Preserve references, ranks, qualifiers and entity revision. Unreferenced statements are candidates, not verified art history. Do not bulk-harvest through unbounded WDQS queries.

name: Europeana
access: API key via verified Europeana account; no credentials configured
metadataRights: Verify relevant metadata agreement at adapter implementation
imageRights: Per-object rights statements; no blanket image permission
warning: An aggregator record is not independent corroboration of its originating museum. New account-based key registration began 2025-05-28.

name: Cleveland Museum of Art
metadataRights: Open-access policy must be attached to selected export
imageRights: Evaluate the actual record and derivative
role: Global objects, materials and collection images
warning: Adapter not implemented; no quota or whole-collection reuse claim inferred.

name: Victoria and Albert Museum
metadataRights: Provider terms apply; not blanket CC0
imageRights: Image-specific terms; see Section 9 and image documentation
role: Decorative arts, design, textiles and material culture
warning: Review metadata and image terms separately; old and current APIs coexist in the docs.

name: Bibliothèque nationale de France
access: SPARQL and downloadable data linked from site
metadataRights: Licence review pending for chosen dataset
warning: This is not proof of a permission to reproduce book pages or a working Gallica adapter.

name: National Gallery of Art, Washington
access: Six-record seed research includes institutional object pages
metadataRights: Manually recorded facts with source references; no copied catalogue essays
imageRights: Explicit public-domain statement on selected object pages
role: Artworks, provenance, creator attribution and images
warning: Selected object image rights do not relicense all page text. A collection-wide ingest adapter remains pending.

name: National Gallery, London
metadataRights: Manually recorded facts; no bulk-text reuse assumed
role: Artist biography, workshop ties and object-specific attribution
warning: Do not merge London and Washington collections or pictures with the same title.

name: Linked Art
access: Model and API reference, not a collection feed
metadataRights: Model documentation; implement mappings, not copy prose
imageRights: Rights objects model permissions, not confer them
role: Interoperability model for objects, people, production and custody events
warning: Local v0.1 is a deliberately smaller read model, not claimed full Linked Art compliance.

name: IIIF
imageRights: Read rights and requiredStatement on actual manifests
role: Interoperable image presentation and canvas identity
warning: An IIIF endpoint does not imply public-domain images. Preserve work/object/image/canvas distinctions.

name: Harvard Art Museums
warning: Do not label docs or integration verified until a successful primary-document read.

name: Smithsonian
access: Search located Open Access FAQ; direct open returned 404
imageRights: Selectively open content; exact current policy not re-read
role: American, Asian and other collection acquisition candidate
warning: No API integration or current licensing verification completed.

name: ColBase, National Institutes for Cultural Heritage
role: Japan-based source candidate to counter Western-collection bias
warning: Do not infer a public API from a search UI.

name: Museum of New Zealand Te Papa Tongarewa
access: Endpoint could not be opened in this pass
warning: Technical openness and cultural permission are separate decisions.

name: Smarthistory
imageRights: Embedded images can carry different rights
warning: No scraped essays or invented summaries. A blocked reference cannot support a completed critic round.
